full_judgment: 4. Mr. Abdul Quayum, learned Counsel, appearing for the petitioners submitted that the High Court Division failed to consider that the suit was filed alleging possession in the suit land through Court 4- hence the decree for khas possession without alleging dispossession is a mistake of law occasioning failure of justice. The learned Counsel further submitted that the High Court Division failed to consider that the plaintiff alleging exclusive possession in his favour was not entitled to decree for khas possession by mere asking thus, committed error of law occasioning failure of justice.
